author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: Overtime was $471 million in FY2025; public-safety departments account for 48% of it.
paragraphs: Headcount is distinct employees paid in the year, which overstates full-time equivalents for departments with seasonal staff (Rec and Park, Library). Overtime share is overtime divided by base plus overtime pay.
High overtime is not automatically waste: minimum staffing rules and vacancies both drive it. The chart pairs overtime share with vacancy-driven headcount changes so readers can see which is at work.

templates.template: FY{fy}, {depts_fmt} departments: {headcount_fmt} employees, overtime {ot_total} ({ot_share} of base plus overtime); {ot100k_fmt} employees earned more than $100,000 in overtime.
templates.fallback: Too few records match to summarize; widen the years or clear a filter.

caveats.text: Employees who worked in two departments in a year are counted in both.
